From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@lightship.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00Z
Subject: Quick favor — trial extension for overnight throughput run

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the dedicated routing behavior you showed looks promising for our endpoint ramp tests. We're planning a 10-hour overnight validation on Tuesday (18:00–04:00 PT) to push sustained 1.2k RPS for 20M tokens total and validate tail latency on multi-region replicas.

We're almost through our evaluation credits but need a short extension + promotional credit top-up to finish the run. Can Redwood do a 72‑hour trial extension and an additional 40k token credit stipend for this night window?

Short answers we need:
- Can you extend the trial through Oct 8th (end of day)?
- Can you provision an additional ~40k tokens promotional allowance?
- Any special routing/region advice for multi-region soak?

I've attached a one-line estimate (lightship-night-run-estimate.csv) with the expected profiles. Happy to jump on a 15-min call if that helps.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Infrastructure
Lightship Analytics

Attachment: lightship-night-run-estimate.csv (CSV, 2 KB)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick favor — trial extension for overnight throughput run

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear runbook and numbers. We can usually support a short extension for a validated POC run like this; I need an internal approval for the promotional allowance.

Quick next steps from our side:
- I'll put a request to our promotions/ops team for a 72-hour trial extension (requested end: 2026-10-08T23:59:59Z).
- Please confirm the exact token units you mean by \"40k\" (total generation tokens vs. input+output) — if it's total output tokens that's different for our billing model.
- Any requirement to pin a model version or region? If you want multi-region routing we recommend pinning to the us-west variant and enabling regional fallback to us-east for capacity.

I'll loop Marissa and Jonas to approve the ad-hoc allowance; if we can get their sign-off early today we can apply the extension before your night run.

— Rachel
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Why I think we should approve:
- This is a low-cost, high-signal test: they are specifically validating tail latency and routing behavior that maps to Redwood's core differentiators (multi-region fallback + KV caching).
- Win here likely leads to a Dedicated evaluation and a larger committed pilot; they referenced a Q4 decision window.
- Their usage estimate is modest (40k tokens generation-ish) relative to a potential deal value.

Asks:
1) Approve a 72-hour trial extension (end 2026-10-08 23:59:59 PT).
2) Approve a one-time promotional allowance of 40,000 tokens (apply as credit to their sandbox project).

If approved, ops will apply the extension and I'll send the account the confirmation + any routing suggestions (pin to us-west, enable fallback to us-east).

I've attached their estimate (lightship-night-run-estimate.csv).

Thanks,
Rachel
